title: My Reflection Stopped Copying Me #shorts #horror
description: The old mirror came with the apartment. Last night, my reflection blinked first. #shorts #horror #scary #creepy #horrorstory

hook.text: Never trust a mirror that came with the house.

lines.text: The apartment was cheap because of one rule.
Then one night, I brushed my teeth and smiled.
It just stared, then slowly raised a finger to its lips.
I threw a towel over the glass and ran to bed.
At three a.m., I heard tapping from the hallway.
From the inside of the mirror.
In the morning, the towel was folded neatly on my pillow.
